tasks.description:
Phase 1. Block D-01: merge Space signals (Block B) + Posts signals (Block C). Confidence-weighted merge. Apply decay_rate model. Output unified OracleSynthesis object per domain per day.

Project root: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight
Target file to CREATE: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight/src/scripts/merge-signals.js
The script must: (1) fetch Space signals (signal_type=spaces_insight) and Post signals (signal_type=hashtag_emergence, thought_leader_alert) from oracleSignals.js, (2) apply confidence-weighted merge: if same topic appears in both ≥2 signal types within 7 days, boost confidence += 15 and set purpose_signal_candidate=true, (3) apply decay_rate_hours: reduce confidence by 5% per elapsed decay window, (4) write merged view back to signals table. Run via crossSignalCorrelation.js patterns. ES module syntax.
